description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the CsvDataImportService, focusing on testing CSV parsing functionality for employee data import in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: CsvDataImportServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing CsvDataImportService functionality related to CSV employee data import.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes CsvDataImportService instance and sample header values before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeArrayFromCSVWithNormalCSVContent
methods.description: Tests parsing of a normal CSV content string into an employee array.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeArrayFromCSVWithLineBreaksInCSV
methods.description: Tests parsing of CSV content with embedded line breaks within quoted fields.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeArrayFromCSVWithSpecialCharactersInCSV
methods.description: Tests parsing of CSV content with special/control characters in fields.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeArrayFromCSVWithNonCSVContent
methods.description: Ensures that non-CSV content throws the appropriate exception.
